tools.name: list_product_lines
tools.description: The product lines Ex2 sells (green shared hosting, WordPress, WooCommerce, email, VPS, dedicated servers, ...), each with its page and the ids of its plans. Start here to find the line that fits a need.

tools.name: list_plans
tools.description: Plans with their prices and main features. Pass line to get one product line (recommended); without it, every plan of every line (about 10,000 tokens).

tools.name: get_plan
tools.description: One plan in detail: prices per billing cycle and first-year discount, features, and its full specification table (disk space, sites, mailboxes, backups, support...).

tools.name: compare_plans
tools.description: Two to 10 plans side by side: each plan's prices, features and specifications, and a comparison with one row per specification and a value per plan. Plans of one product line compare row by row; plans of different lines share few rows.

tools.name: get_domain_pricing
tools.description: One-year prices to register, transfer and renew a domain name, per extension, with the link to order one. Pass tlds with the extensions you need (e.g. ["com", "ca", "fr"]); without it, every extension Ex2 sells, which is a long list.

tools.name: check_domain
tools.description: Whether a domain name can be registered at Ex2 right now (live WHOIS, results kept 5 minutes), with the one-year register, transfer and renewal prices of its extension and the link to order it (or to transfer it, when taken). One name per call; limited to 120 checks per 10 minutes.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_product_lines · Private data: list_plans · Public sink: list_product_lines, compare_plans.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_product_lines · Private data: list_plans · Public sink: list_product_lines, compare_plans

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
